### Landman — Power, Money & Survival

Landman (2024) follows Tommy Norris, a seasoned crisis manager working in the high-stakes oil industry of West Texas. As a landman for a powerful oil company, Tommy operates between wealthy executives, oil-field workers, landowners, and dangerous criminals, trying to keep the business running while managing problems that can spiral out of control.

Working in an industry driven by money, ambition, and risk, Tommy faces constant pressure to protect the company's interests. From deadly accidents and legal disputes to conflicts with powerful business figures, every decision carries serious consequences. As the stakes rise, he must use his experience, negotiation skills, and street smarts to navigate a world where one mistake can cost millions—or even lives.

Outside work, Tommy struggles to balance his demanding career with complicated family relationships. The pressure of his job follows him home, forcing him to confront the personal costs of living in an industry where business often comes before everything else.

The series explores themes of ambition, greed, family, power, and the human cost of the oil business. It reveals how the pursuit of wealth can create opportunities while exposing people to dangerous choices and unpredictable consequences.

What makes Landman compelling is watching Tommy navigate the brutal realities of the oil industry, where intelligence, negotiation, and quick decisions can mean the difference between keeping control and losing everything.

💬 In the oil business, everyone wants a piece of the money—but someone always has to deal with the consequences.
